description.value: Gibsons Visitor Centre is the official tourism information office for Gibsons, operated by the Gibsons Chamber of Commerce on BC's Sunshine Coast. Located at unit 101 on South Fletcher Road, it serves as a first stop for visitors arriving to this ferry-accessible coastal community. Touring cyclists riding the Sunshine Coast route would find it a natural stop for local maps, route advice, and community information.
